intentComment: Story 122 Script B (sprint sya-antimatter-cutover) - MAINNET Antimatter/sUSDS cutover (script/CutoverAntimatterPoolMainnet.s.sol; runbook docs/SyaAntimatterMainnetCutover.md). Refuses if the AM/sUSDS pair already exists (griefing risk R1), deploys AntimatterPoolSeeder, moves 10% (lpForBps(1_000)) of UniPoolerV2's phUSD/sUSDS LP: rescue -> approve -> grant AM minter -> seed (pro-rata floors -0.1%) -> revoke AM minter (always) -> pair read-back, asserting supply-neutral burn/mint, pair reserve, pooler LP and an empty seeder. Resumable (progress server/deployments/progress.antimatter-pool.1.json). PREFER A PRIVATE RPC for :broadcast (e.g. RPC_MAINNET=<Flashbots Protect URL> npm run antimatter-pool:broadcast). :broadcast = backup, Ledger m/44'/60'/46'/0/0 (gas price ANTIMATTER_POOL_GAS_PRICE_WEI, default 0.3 gwei), patcher FILLS AntimatterPoolSeeder + AntimatterSusdsPair, :verify, tax ledger (LEDGER_NOTE suggestion: 'protocol-owned LP conversion phUSD/sUSDS -> AM/sUSDS'); :verify = read-only script/VerifyAntimatterPoolCutover.s.sol; :etherscan = OPTIONAL unchained source verification of the seeder. Run uniswap-helper:* only AFTER this has landed and been patched.

preview.note: PREVIEW_MODE -> vm.startPrank(OWNER); _writeProgress returns early, so NO progress file is written in preview.

broadcast.command: node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && export ANTIMATTER_POOL_GAS_PRICE_WEI=${ANTIMATTER_POOL_GAS_PRICE_WEI:-300000000} && forge script script/CutoverAntimatterPoolMainnet.s.sol:CutoverAntimatterPoolMainnet --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --sender 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price $ANTIMATTER_POOL_GAS_PRICE_WEI --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-antimatter-pool.js && npm run antimatter-pool:verify && node scripts/ledger-record.js CutoverAntimatterPoolMainnet.s.sol 1
broadcast.note: Progress file written during forge's LOCAL pass (before txs land) in broadcast mode only; written at Step 2 (in_progress), after seed (in_progress, seeded=true) and at end (completed).

etherscan.note: OPTIONAL, unchained; reads seeder address from progress.antimatter-pool.1.json; constructor args hard-coded (OWNER, phUSD, sUSDS, Antimatter, Router02, PhusdSusdsPair, UniPoolerV2) - match the address book at 669cbc1.

forgeTarget.base: AntimatterPoolMainnetBase (same file; also imported by the verifier)

jsChain.joinedWith: && (each tail step runs only on zero exit of the previous)
